QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Up On The Walls 1
QuestInfo.0: The banquet hall is in chaos following the appearance of the Prime Minister. The Head Security Officer asked for your help.
QuestInfo.1: The Head Security Officer said they beefed up their land defenses, but not the seaward ones. The Vikings are already anchored at the back gates. Help the mushrooms by eliminating the Vikings climbing up the castle walls.
QuestInfo.2: The Vikings swarmed over the rear gates. You've stopped them for now, but the situation is grim.

0.0: You were right. We were fooled by his incredible disguise skills. In any event, the Vikings will not be easy to repel. Their airship is already anchored above the rear gates of the castle.
0.1: It's my mistake for focusing our defenses on the front gates. I never expected an attack from the rear! Please, we need your help.

yes.0: We're trying to get the rear gates closed again, but we need you to push back the #r#o3300102##k monsters from the walls. If we lose the walls, the gates are next, and then it's all over.

1.0: Did you drive the Vikings from our castle walls?

yes.0: Things are falling apart faster than I expected. Our soldiers are getting stomped by the Vikings. They're not trained for this kind of stress!

default.0: Please eliminate the #r#o3300102##k monsters trying to take over our castle walls.
